items.source: If life is brought below 0, cancels the attack, heals for %d and deals %0.2f lightning damage in radius %d as well as dazing for 2 turns.
items.target: 若生命值降至 0 以下，则取消此次攻击、恢复 %d 点生命值，并在 %d 格范围内造成 %0.2f 点闪电伤害，同时使目标眩晕 3 回合。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat with reorder {1,3,2} so Chinese placeholders are life, radius, damage. Unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: AED=电击除颤器. The English status key still says 2 turns; Chinese follows the effect code, not the English key wording.

items.source: Engaged in automated repairs, preventing any action but increasing life regen by %d, all resistances by %d%% and preventing death until falling below -%d life.
items.target: 进入自动修复模式，无法行动，但生命恢复速率增加 %d ，生命值回满时立即结束该模式，全部抗性提升 %d%%，死亡生命下限为 -%d 。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Automated Repair System=自动修复系统. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua EFF_AUTOMATED_REPAIR_SYSTEM: activate sets never_act, life_regen, resists.all, and a negative die_at; on_timeout removes the effect when self.life == self.max_life. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/mecharachnid.lua Automated Repair System on lethal incoming hit. All Resists terminology is 全部抗性 (resists.all).

items.source: The target is covered in burning chemicals, taking %0.2f fire damage each turn. Subsequent shots deal %0.2f fire damage, and if they fall below 25%% life they have a %d%% chance to panic.
items.target: 目标被燃烧的化学物质所覆盖，每回合受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害。之后的射击会立即造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害；施加者死亡后，该效果会在目标下次行动时结束。若目标生命值低于 25%% 且能够行动，则有 %d%% 的几率慌乱逃跑。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Burning Phosphorous=燃烧的磷. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_BURNING_PHOSPHOROUS: on_timeout deals fire damage each turn; on_merge immediately deals initdam fire and refreshes duration to 3 turns; callbackOnAct removes the effect when eff.src.dead; panic check only if life/max_life < 0.25 and enoughEnergy, then %d%% flee (resistable via mental save / fear immunity). Apply path <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/damage_types.lua PHOSPHOROUS projector if attacker knows Incendiary Powder. fire=火焰.

items.source: Hovering in place, gaining %d%% evasion, %d%% movement speed and launching a powerful rocket barrage each turn.
items.target: 目标悬浮在空中，获得 %d%% 躲闪概率， %d%% 移动速度；可手动使用火箭弹幕再次发射，使用其他任何技能会立即结束该效果。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Death From Above=死亡天降; Rocket Barrage=火箭弹幕. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_DEATH_FROM_ABOVE: activate grants evasion, projectile_evasion, movement_speed, levitation, avoid_pressure_traps, and learns Rocket Barrage; no on_timeout auto-fire. callbackOnTalentPost removes the effect unless the used talent has rocket_barrage. Rocket Barrage in <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/artillery.lua fires only when used and has rocket_barrage. Seeker Warhead apply fires once then sets the effect for 3 turns.

items.source: Direct control by the pilot increases damage by %d%% and resistances by %d%%.
items.target: 机械蜘蛛被驾驶员直接控制，增加全部伤害 %d%%，增加全部抗性 %d%%；每回合使非固定冷却技能额外减少 1 回合冷却。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Direct Control=直接控制. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua EFF_MECHARACHNID_PILOTING_BUFF: activate adds inc_damage all and resists.all; decrease=0; on_timeout removes the buff if EFF_MECHARACHNID_PILOTING is gone, then extra -1 on each talents_cd entry whose talent is not fixed_cooldown unless no_talents_cooldown. items.source: Provides a frost aura, giving you +%d%% fire, light, and lightning affinity.

items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Fiery Salve=烈火药剂; Frost Salve uses 寒霜光环 and 亲和. items.source: The target is very itchy, causing their actions to fail.
items.target: 太痒了，技能有几率施放失败。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Itching Powder=痒痒粉. items.source: Target is being assailed by an automated saw blade that cuts its flesh for %0.2f physical damage each turn%s. When the effect expires, the saw will explode for %0.2f fire damage and fly back to its source, pulling the target with it (up to %d tiles).
items.target: 你被飞锯击伤，每回合受到 %0.2f 物理伤害 %s。仅当持续时间自然结束且施加者仍在场时，飞锯才会爆炸，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害并飞回其来源；仅当你可被击退时，才会被拉向施加者（最多 %d 格）。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Explosive Saw=爆炸飞锯. Public source <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua EFF_EXPLOSIVE_WOUND: on_timeout physical damage; deactivate specials only if eff.dur < 0 and eff.src exists, is not dead, and has coordinates; pull requires canBe knockback. Talent apply <DLC_ROOT>/orcs/tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/automated-butchery.lua Explosive Saw for 4 turns. Early removal does not explode. physical=物理; fire=火焰.

items.source: You lay moss where you walk.

items.source: The target is surrounded by a static shield, increasing all resistances by %d%% and causing attacks against them to trigger a shield attack for %d%% damage as lightning.
items.target: 目标被静电力场包围，增加全部抗性 %d%%；受到攻击时，将使用原施放者的盾牌造成 %d%% 伤害的闪电反击，且同一攻击者每回合最多触发一次。
items.bounded_fixed_context: source_tag=tformat; unique runtime key in tome-orcs.lua. Nearby: Static Shield=静电力场. T_STATIC_SHOCK (talents/steam/magnetism.lua) after successful Block applies EFF_STATIC_SHIELD for 4 turns to the caster and to act.turret minions with src=self (the caster). items.target: 全部抗性提高 %d%%，新施加的负面效果持续时间缩短 %d%%，近战命中持有者的生物受到 %0.2f 点火焰伤害。

items.source: Newly applied status effects durations are reduced by %d%%.
